# MIRU

> MIRU (https://miru.plus) is an interactive romance-story and AI character chat app. Readers play as themselves, talk with the characters and make choices in every chapter that change relationships, the plot and the ending. Stories are written by the MIRU team; characters' live replies are generated by AI within each story's written personalities and safety rules. All characters are fictional adults. Free to start, in the browser on phone or computer; available in English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Spanish.

## Key pages

- [Home / play](https://miru.plus/): the app itself
- [All stories](https://miru.plus/stories/): catalog with premise, characters and chapters for every story

## Stories

- [Confess Your Darkest Desire](https://miru.plus/stories/confess-your-darkest-desire.html): At midnight, inside a confessional that has been sealed for seven years, a man describes the clothes your missing mother wore on her last known day. ‘A blue coat. One button missing.’
- [The Devil Who Knows My Name](https://miru.plus/stories/the-devil-who-knows-my-name.html): At two in the morning, you slam a detention order onto the desk of New York crime boss Roman Moretti. His signature is right there. ‘Did you kill my brother?’
- [My Fiancé’s Forbidden Brother](https://miru.plus/stories/my-fianc-s-forbidden-brother.html): Twelve hours before your wedding, you catch Ethan kissing another woman at the rehearsal. He sees you and smiles. ‘Going to my brother? You've wanted to for a while.’
- [My Three Roommates Shift at Midnight](https://miru.plus/stories/my-three-roommates-shift-at-midnight.html): You inherit an old New York observatory—and three tenants who change shape when the midnight bell rings.
- [The Villain Kissed Me First](https://miru.plus/stories/the-villain-kissed-me-first.html): The hero saved you. The villain says the foundation already knew your name.
- [I Kissed My Professor](https://miru.plus/stories/i-kissed-my-professor.html): The stranger you kissed last night is your professor this morning.
- [Ashes of Us](https://miru.plus/stories/ashes-of-us.html): Fifteen years ago, you only heard half the story. A new exhibition brings you face to face with the woman you once loved.
- [The Plus-One Pact](https://miru.plus/stories/the-plus-one-pact.html): He said he’d wanted you for fourteen months. Now he might leave in thirty days.
- [Letters From Tomorrow](https://miru.plus/stories/letters-from-tomorrow.html): You got a breakup letter from seven days in the future. Then the man it named walked in.
- [The Dragon's Last Trial](https://miru.plus/stories/the-dragon-s-last-trial.html): The dragon begs for a death sentence. A second man tears up his own protection to stop the trial.
- [The Bride’s Reckoning](https://miru.plus/stories/the-bride-s-reckoning.html): You came to restore an old wedding film. The bride who vanished twelve years ago is waiting inside it for your answer.
- [OFF CAMERA](https://miru.plus/stories/off-camera.html): After the cameras stop, four men wait for your yes.
- [She Ruined My First Show](https://miru.plus/stories/she-ruined-my-first-show.html): She kissed you the night before your debut. She ended your show the next morning.
- [Arrest the Man I Loved](https://miru.plus/stories/arrest-the-man-i-loved.html): A stormy-night murder scene. The suspect behind the tape is the ex who walked out on you three years ago.
- [The Wolf King's Rejected Mate](https://miru.plus/stories/the-wolf-king-s-rejected-mate.html): You refused the Wolf King's fated bond—but when a second moon mark appears on the doctor's wrist, even the moon must choose.
- [He Begged After Divorce](https://miru.plus/stories/he-begged-after-divorce.html): Three months after the divorce, the woman who loved your ex for two years takes credit for your design — and the transfer contract has your signature you never signed.
- [Who's Lying Tonight?](https://miru.plus/stories/who-s-lying-tonight.html): My missing friend just sent a five-year-old photo of me in New York—but I wasn't there.
- [Nightshift: The Last Vampire ER](https://miru.plus/stories/nightshift-the-last-vampire-er.html): Midnight at New York's last ER for the nightfolk: the patient in Room Seven died years ago—on paper.
- [The Younger Man: Five Reasons to Stay](https://miru.plus/stories/the-younger-man-five-reasons-to-stay.html): Five men younger than you all want to stay by your side—but every one of them hid the same thing from you.
- [Puppy Love House](https://miru.plus/stories/puppy-love-house.html): Your first night in Brooklyn, five men say "Welcome home" at once—but they already know your name.
- [The Villainess They Refused to Kill](https://miru.plus/stories/the-villainess-they-refused-to-kill.html): On your hundredth execution night, six men who once caused your death stand between you and the executioner.
- [Off Stage: Six Idols, One Secret](https://miru.plus/stories/off-stage-six-idols-one-secret.html): On your first day, a photo from three years ago shows you standing with them. Someone is forging their past with your face.
- [The City Fears Him, He Fears My Tears](https://miru.plus/stories/the-city-fears-him-he-fears-my-tears.html): When her boss frames her for stealing $180K, the most feared man in the city kneels to pick up her papers.
- [Off Limits: The Hockey Boys](https://miru.plus/stories/off-limits-the-hockey-boys.html): On your first day, a hidden camera arrives before you do. Five players’ secrets lead back to an accident three years ago.
- [The Gods Want Your Answer](https://miru.plus/stories/the-gods-want-your-answer.html): Three gods offer you their best love, but only you can decide.
- [The Last Light Inn](https://miru.plus/stories/the-last-light-inn.html): 21 days, three men, and a seaside inn waiting for your decision.
- [The Vampire Who Remembers Me](https://miru.plus/stories/the-vampire-who-remembers-me.html): He remembers losing you ninety-nine times in the same seven days. This time, tomorrow need not cost your life.
- [The System Made Me Love My Killer](https://miru.plus/stories/the-system-made-me-love-my-killer.html): He killed you last time, but the system called it a success—now you're getting close again, just to make him hand over the evidence.
- [Everyone Wants You](https://miru.plus/stories/everyone-wants-you.html): Three men. One island. Every choice is yours.
- [Reborn in the Freeze](https://miru.plus/stories/reborn-in-the-freeze.html): Last time they cast you into the blizzard. Now they're knocking.
- [I Died Once. They Remember.](https://miru.plus/stories/i-died-once-they-remember.html): You died on your engagement night. Then you woke up seven days earlier — and three men remember your death.
- [Northlight Still Burns](https://miru.plus/stories/northlight-still-burns.html): Day twelve on the death list, you ring the bell yourself—and hear your own eulogy being read inside.
- [The Eighth Vow](https://miru.plus/stories/the-eighth-vow.html): Seven marriage contracts. Seven princes. All of them swear to protect you—so who erased your name?
- [Eclipse Oath](https://miru.plus/stories/eclipse-oath.html): Three wolf seals, an inherited manor, and an oath you can choose to change.
- [Crown of Midnight](https://miru.plus/stories/crown-of-midnight.html): Condemned to death, you watch your executioner lower his sword as the crown shatters—and four men with old grudges each want to claim you.
- [The Unread Choice](https://miru.plus/stories/the-unread-choice.html): A crown, an unfinished song, and a future only you can choose.
- [Black Harbor: Reckless Favor](https://miru.plus/stories/black-harbor-reckless-favor.html): The mob wants you to take the fall, but two dangerous men will turn on everyone to protect you.
- [Eight Princes, One Crown](https://miru.plus/stories/eight-princes-one-crown.html): Eight princes were meant to fight for the throne. Instead, the Crown chose you—and every prince has a reason to win your heart.
- [Tonight, Favor Runs Wild](https://miru.plus/stories/tonight-favor-runs-wild.html): On premiere night, the investor who owns the room and the leading man everyone's watching both want to sit beside you—and the moment you play favorites, the other can't hide it.
- [Midnight Invitation](https://miru.plus/stories/midnight-invitation.html): Three men are planning a midnight just for you.
- [The Mafia King’s Only Weakness](https://miru.plus/stories/the-mafia-king-s-only-weakness.html): He can stop a billion-dollar deal. Your answer is something he has to wait for.

## FAQ

- Is MIRU free? Yes, every story can be started for free; optional extra scenes use diamonds that can also be earned by playing.
- Do I need to download an app? No. MIRU runs in any modern browser at https://miru.plus on phones and computers.
- Is the content explicit? No sexually explicit content; all characters are fictional adults (17+ audience).
